ValidationRule.description: This rule will prevent users for modifying BPS Tasks
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR($User.Id <> Owner:User.Id, AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $User.Id <> PRIORVALUE(OwnerId))), $User.Id <> CreatedById, NOT($Permission.Edit_BPS_Tasks), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'BPS_task_RT', NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not eligible to update this Task.
